name: formularios-web
description: Plataforma de formularios operativos ADN — migracion desde Microsoft Forms

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w api && npm run type-check -w web
